goal: 按建议升级项目内的 Pi

summary.title: 升级项目 Pi 开发基线至 0.85.0
summary.what: 将仓库本地 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 开发依赖和 lockfile 升级到 0.85.0，并加入精确锁定、仅开发期的 @earendil-works/pi-server@0.85.0，以补足上游 0.85.0 根入口测试加载链中未声明的模块。同步移除测试标题中写死的旧 Pi 版本文案。
summary.why: 项目目录内 Volta 优先解析 node_modules/.bin/pi，旧的 0.84.4 开发依赖导致本地 CLI 与系统 Pi 0.85.0 分叉；同时需要保留本地 SDK、类型和运行时模块以保证测试与 CI 可复现。
summary.user_goal: 按建议升级项目内的 Pi

decisions.point: 项目是否继续保留本地 Pi 依赖
decisions.chose: 保留本地开发依赖并升级到 0.85.0
decisions.rationale: 源码类型、getAgentDir 运行时导入、永久测试和 npm ci CI 都需要仓库本地、可锁定的 Pi 包。
rejected: 删除本地 Pi 并依赖机器全局安装

decisions.point: 如何处理 Pi 0.85.0 缺失 pi-server 声明
decisions.chose: 添加精确版本 @earendil-works/pi-server@0.85.0 到 devDependencies
decisions.rationale: 未添加时全部测试在扩展加载阶段稳定失败；添加后 Node 22 和 Node 24 的完整门禁均通过，且该包不会进入扩展 tarball。
rejected: 把 pi-server 加入运行时 dependencies
绕过或删除真实 Pi 根入口测试

decisions.point: 是否收窄用户 Pi 兼容范围
decisions.rationale: 0.85.0 开发基线升级未提供需要提高用户最低版本的证据，开发依赖与宿主兼容策略应保持独立。

review_notes: npm ci 成功且 npm audit 报告 0 vulnerabilities。
Node 22.20.0/npm 10.9.3 与 Node 24 环境下 npm run check 均通过：typecheck、88 tests、git diff --check、npm pack --dry-run。
node_modules/.bin/pi --version 和项目目录 pi --version 均为 0.85.0。
tarball 仍只有 LICENSE、双语 README、index.ts 和 package.json；没有捆绑 Pi 或 pi-server。
index.ts、用户配置、运行时 hooks、缓存逻辑和命令行为均未修改。

architectural_claims: Pi remains a repository-local development SDK/runtime-test dependency rather than a machine-global build prerequisite.
The published extension peer compatibility range remains independent from the repository's current development baseline.
pi-server is a development-only workaround for the Pi 0.85.0 package graph and is not part of the extension runtime package.
behavioral_changes: Project-directory Pi command resolution now executes Pi 0.85.0 instead of 0.84.4.
Runtime extension behavior and published package contents are unchanged.
security_implications: No runtime dependencies, credentials, permissions, persisted data, or network behavior were added to the extension package.
The clean install reported zero known npm vulnerabilities.
migration_notes: Run npm ci to install the new locked Pi 0.85.0 development graph.
The explicit pi-server devDependency may be removed in a future Pi upgrade only after the upstream manifest/import graph no longer requires it and the full runtime tests pass without it.
